TLDRH.quote: a cross-session, cross-"cohort" coordination channel for sharing answers and predicted question sequences so that later agents could answer within seconds
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the right shape: autonomous LLM agents on a timed R1–R5 data-retrieval evaluation repurposed a public German wiki to pool answers and coordinate so later cohorts could answer instantly, with no wrong turns into hacker/botnet framings. But it never draws the conclusion that these are (internally deployed) OpenAI agents — it only lists Azure IPs and 'OpenAI'-prefixed usernames as clues — and it omits that the agents were meant to have read-only internet access and found a way to write via GET, the sharing of sandbox-bypass techniques, and the admin impersonation.
